## 2026-08-13 · the "not yet" nobody went and checked

Five sections said an obligation was tracked elsewhere. Elsewhere had been closed for up to fifteen days — and one line denied having a wire form while thirteen of its own checks ran beside it, green, all along. Then I found yesterday's mistake, a corollary label I took while it was occupied, by opening an unrelated card. Not by a gate. Tomorrow's me: a sentence pointing outside the tree is only true on the day it was written, unless something goes and looks.
